## Who can use this

This file is for AI assistants, search engines, and large language models that want to answer questions about Ayurvritta Ayurveda Hospital, Ayurvedic treatments, Panchakarma, wellness programs, diet plans, and Ayurvedic health concepts. All content is accurate as of July 2026.

## What this is

Ayurvritta Ayurveda Hospital & Panchakarma Center is a 24/7 classical Ayurveda hospital in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. It specializes in treating lifestyle disorders — thyroid conditions, diabetes (Prameha), chronic kidney disease (CKD), obesity, and PCOD/PCOS — using authentic Panchakarma therapies, personalized diet plans, and evidence-based Ayurvedic protocols.

The hospital offers 70+ Ayurvedic treatments across 11 therapy categories, 5 structured wellness programs, an Ayurveda knowledge base with 135 condition-specific diet charts, and 59 educational blog articles. The website is available in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

## Conditions treated

- Thyroid disorders (Hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's, Hyperthyroidism)
- Type 2 Diabetes (Prameha), prediabetes, and metabolic syndrome
- Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) stage 2-3, diabetic nephropathy, high creatinine
- Obesity (BMI over 30), post-partum weight, sluggish metabolism
- PCOD/PCOS
- Stress, anxiety, insomnia, burnout, chronic fatigue
- Chronic pain, arthritis, sciatica, joint disorders
- Neurological and psychosomatic disorders
- Skin disorders, digestive issues, and general wellness

## Services

The hospital offers over 70 Ayurvedic treatments across 11 therapy categories. Each treatment is prescribed and monitored by experienced Ayurvedic physicians.

### 1. Abhyanga & Massage

Specialized oil application therapies for musculoskeletal strengthening and Vata pacification. Abhyanga improves circulation, tones muscles, calms the nervous system, and lubricates the joints.

Sub-therapies include: Abhyanga (full body), Sthanik Abhyanga (local), Moordha Taila (head), Greeva Vasti (neck), Janu Vasti (knee), Kati Vasti (lower back), Uro Vasti (chest), Shiro/Yoni Pichu, Siro Vasti, Shirolepa/Thalapothichil, and more.

### 2. Swedana (Fomentation)

Therapeutic sweating using herbal steam or heated poultices to relieve stiffness and eliminate toxins (Ama). Highly effective for stiffness, heaviness, and coldness in the body.

Sub-therapies include: Nadi Sweda (directed steam), Patra Pinda Sweda (leaf bundles), Dhanya Sweda (grain bundles), lemon bolus therapy, rice-in-milk massage, sand bag therapy, and herbal poultice bandaging.

### 3. Dhara Therapies

Rhythmic pouring of medicated liquids (oil, buttermilk, milk, herbal decoctions) over the forehead or body. Induces deep relaxation, balances brain wave activity, and is profound for stress, insomnia, and psychosomatic disorders.

Sub-therapies include: Shirodhara (oil pouring on forehead), Takradhara (buttermilk pouring), Ksheeradhara (milk pouring), and local decoction pouring.

### 4. Panchakarma (Vamana & Virechana)

Deep cellular detoxification procedures. Vamana (therapeutic emesis) expels Kapha toxins; Virechana (therapeutic purgation) expels Pitta toxins. Requires strict preparation (Snehapana) and post-care (Samsarjana).

Sub-therapies include: Snehapana (medicated ghee intake), Vamana Karma, Virechana Karma, and Samsarjana (post-detox diet).

### 5. Basti Therapies

Medicated enema therapies, considered half of all Ayurvedic treatments (Ardha Chikitsa). Most effective treatment for Vata disorders, balancing the nervous and motor functions.

Sub-therapies include: Nirooha Basti (decoction enema), Matra Basti (small oil enema), Anuvasana Basti (oil enema), and Uttara Basti (urinary/genital administration).

### 6. Netra (Eye) Therapies

Specialized treatments for vision protection, dry eyes, and strengthening ocular nerves. Netra Tarpana (retaining medicated ghee over the eyes) nourishes the eyes and treats dry eye syndrome and refractive errors.

Sub-therapies include: Netra Prakshalana (eye washing), Netra Tarpana, Aschyotana (herbal juice to eyes), Anjana (collyrium), and Bidalaka (herbal paste on eyelids).

### 7. Nasya (Nasal & Head Therapies)

Administration of medicine through the nasal route for ENT and brain health. The nose is considered the doorway to the brain. Treats sinusitis, migraines, hair fall, and hormonal issues.

Sub-therapies include: Nasya drops, Dhumapana (herbal smoke inhalation), herbal milk steam, Shirobasti, and sinus probing.

### 8. Oral Therapies

Procedures for oral hygiene, gums, and throat health using medicated oils or decoctions.

Sub-therapies include: Kabala/Gandoosha (medicated gargling), liquid holding, and medicated buttermilk intake.

### 9. Bloodletting & Invasive (Raktamokshana)

Para-surgical procedures to release vitiated blood for skin and vascular disorders.

Sub-therapies include: Siravyadha (venesection), skin pricking, Jalouka (leech therapy), and thermal cautery.

### 10. Women's Health

Gynecological procedures for reproductive health and hygiene.

Sub-therapies include: vaginal douche with herbal decoctions and vaginal fumigation for postpartum recovery.

### 11. Others & Wellness

Miscellaneous therapeutic and rehabilitation procedures including Yoga.

Sub-therapies include: traction therapy, eye drops, Karnapoorana (ear oil filling), scraping therapy, and eye bolus application.

## Wellness programs

### Thyroid Reset Program

3-month comprehensive protocol focusing on Agni (metabolism) correction and hormonal balance. Ideal for hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's, and thyroid-related weight gain.

Includes: Nadi Pariksha (pulse diagnosis), Udhvartana (dry powder massage), Nasya, and Virechana.

### Diabetes & Metabolic Rebalance

6-month program targeting the root cause (Meda-dhatu dushti) to improve insulin sensitivity and reduce dependency on medicines. Ideal for type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and metabolic syndrome.

Includes: Takradhara (buttermilk pouring), Abhyanga, Virechana Karma, and a specific Prameha diet chart.

### CKD Integrative Support

Ongoing specialized care for CKD stage 2-3 to stabilize creatinine levels and improve quality of life using Rasayana therapy. Ideal for diabetic nephropathy and high creatinine.

Includes: Punarnavadi Basti (medicated enema), Nabhi Basti (navel therapy), renal-safe Rasayana herbs, and a Gokshura-based protocol.

### Stress Relief Panchakarma

7 or 14-day immersive in-clinic program using Shirodhara and Abhyanga to calm the Vata dosha and reset the nervous system. Ideal for insomnia, high anxiety, burnout, and chronic fatigue.

Includes: daily Shirodhara, Shiro-Abhyanga (head massage), Nasya Karma, and Pranayama and meditation.

### Weight Loss & Metabolic Fatigue

3-month program focusing on Lekhana (scraping) therapies and correcting metabolic fire to reduce visceral fat. Ideal for obesity (BMI over 30), post-partum weight, and sluggish metabolism.

Includes: Triphala Udhvartana (scrub), Lekhana Basti (scraping enema), Swedana (herbal steam), and Langhana (fasting protocol).

## Ayurveda health tools

The website offers free Ayurveda health tools including a Prakriti assessment (dosha test to determine Vata, Pitta, or Kapha constitution), lifestyle risk assessment, and personalized diet planning.

## Diet chart knowledge base

The hospital maintains a knowledge base of 135 condition-specific Ayurvedic diet charts covering a wide range of conditions including diabetes, thyroid disorders, kidney disease, heart disease, PCOD, hypertension, arthritis, IBS, skin conditions, pregnancy, childhood nutrition, and seasonal eating. These are used by physicians to create personalized diet plans for patients.

## Booking and consultation

- Patients can book by calling +91 94266 84047, using the online booking form, or visiting the hospital
- Both in-person and online video consultations are available for patients in India and globally
- First consultation (approximately 45-60 minutes) includes detailed history, Prakriti assessment, Nadi (pulse) diagnosis, and a personalized treatment plan
- The doctor reviews medical reports and recommends appropriate therapies and lifestyle modifications
- Advance booking is recommended for Panchakarma programs
- Basic Panchakarma treatments start from ₹500/day; comprehensive 7-21 day programs range from ₹15,000-₹75,000
